name: blood-donor-search-eraktkosh-sync
description: Temporary standalone tool that keeps bank_stock fresh by reading e-RaktKosh's public stock-availability page (Playwright, since the page has no plain HTTP endpoint - see README.md). Not part of the Next.js app in frontend/ - nothing here is imported by it. Meant to be replaced by src/api-source.mjs once real APISetu credentials for e-RaktKosh's official API come through (see README.md).
